appimage.title: Universal Linux AppImage
appimage.note: Manual option. Recommended: use the Linux quick-install command above to select and verify the package for your distro.

pacman.title: Arch Linux
pacman.note: Direct .pacman download. The quick installer detects Arch, cleans up the old alternatives launcher if needed, and installs this package.

aur.title: Arch Linux / Manjaro / EndeavourOS
aur.note: PKGBUILD is built and verified working end-to-end, but AUR account registration is temporarily closed — not yet pushed to the actual AUR. Use the pacman package above in the meantime.

exe.title: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit Installer
exe.note: The Windows installer is not published yet. It will be available here after the native Windows build is complete.

dmg.title: macOS Apple Silicon Disk Image
dmg.note: The Apple Silicon installer is not published yet. It will be available here after the native macOS build is complete.

x64Dmg.title: macOS Intel Disk Image
x64Dmg.note: The Intel Mac installer is not published yet. It will be available here after the native macOS build is complete.

features.desc: Run headless 1000Hz MuJoCo simulation & RNEA dynamics compensation
Trigger 10-phase causal cognitive loop & synthesize procedural skills
Compute 6-DOF spatial forward kinematics & joint gravity torques in 0.018ms
Export OpenCASCADE B-Rep solid model to ISO-10303-242 (STEP AP242)
Inspect and manage in-device Ollama reasoning models

studio.label: Early Access License
includes: ROS 2 package export from your robot description: URDF, controller config and launch file
Bill of materials export (CSV and Markdown)

All 12 AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot and more

studio.activation: After checkout you get a license file by email. Paste it into Settings → Account in NELO Studio.
